title: Harappan NPC pack, illustration v1 / dialogue v1
scope: These NPCs are fictional, styled for a Grade 7 side-scrolling history game; the Harappan script remains undeciphered. Speech is modern English for gameplay, not translation. Clothing styles and people are interpretations rather than archaeologically certain reconstructions. Features such as sari-like drapes and sandals are artistic conventions and may need revision.
notes: Spaced by approximate game chronology; use a shared coordinate transform for drawn figures and interaction prompts. Art is a PNG sheet of ten 64x64 cells at x=64*index, y=0. Every cell has transparent padding, foot-aligned at bottom. Player can speak when overlapping on screen. Current loop is only for testing, not a cyclical historical claim.
